file:
  win25cis_2_3_1_3_newadministratorname:
    title: "2.3.1.3 | Configure 'Accounts: Rename administrator account' | NewAdministratorName"
    path: '{{ .Vars.win25cis_snapshot_dir }}\SystemAccess.NewAdministratorName'
    exists: true
    contents:
      - '/^.+$/'
      - '!/^Administrator$/'
    meta:
      domaincontroller: 1
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 2.3.1.3
      NIST800-53R5:
        - IA-5
    {{ end }}
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/section_2.3.1.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/section_2.3.1/cis_2.3.1.3.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

No runnable check (when: 'adminchangethis' not in win25cis_admin_username); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.1.3 | PATCH | Configure Accounts Rename administrator account"
  when:
    - win25cis_rule_2_3_1_3
    - not (win_skip_for_test | bool)
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_2.3.1.3
    - patch
    - securitypolicy
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5
  block:
    - name: "2.3.1.3 | PATCH | Configure Accounts Rename administrator account | Make Changes To Admin Name"
      when: "'adminchangethis' not in win25cis_admin_username"
      community.windows.win_security_policy:
        section: System Access
        key: newadministratorname
        value: "{{ win25cis_admin_username }}"

    - name: "2.3.1.3 | AUDIT | Configure Accounts Rename administrator account | Warning Msg For Default Variable Not Edited"
      when: "'adminchangethis' in win25cis_admin_username"
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have not changed the default admin username in win25cis_admin_username please"
          - "make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "2.3.1.3 | AUDIT | Configure Accounts Rename administrator account | Add Warn Count"
      when: "'adminchangethis' in win25cis_admin_username"
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '2.3.1.3'
